options.B: Installing grab bars near the toilet and inside the shower stall
options.C: Placing plush cotton bath mats over slippery tiled floors
options.D: Lowering the overall water temperature in the household heater

explanation: Grab bars provide essential physical support during high-risk transfers in wet, slippery bathroom environments. [learn more](GNS321_U3_T6#GNS321_U3_T6_h7)

question: How does the clinical concept of reaction severity differ fundamentally from causality?

options.A: Severity can only be calculated by laboratory technicians, whereas causality is determined solely by bedside nurses
options.B: Severity applies exclusively to herbal remedies, whereas causality applies only to synthetic antibiotics
options.C: Severity is measured in financial costs, whereas causality is measured in physical recovery days
options.D: Severity measures the intensity of the patient's clinical outcome, whereas causality determines the likelihood that the drug caused it

explanation: Causality looks at the cause-and-effect link between drug and event, while severity evaluates how damaging or life-threatening the resulting reaction was. [learn more](GNS215_U2_T6#GNS215_U2_T6_h6)

question: What is a direct clinical consequence of a poorly organised nursing unit?

options.A: Improved collaboration among multidisciplinary teams
options.B: Increased risk of delayed medications and staff burnout
options.C: Faster patient recovery and shorter hospital stays
options.D: Enhanced adherence to international nursing standards

explanation: Lack of structural coordination and chaotic workflows typically result in missed care, medication errors, and physical exhaustion among nursing personnel. [learn more](GST321_U6_T1#GST321_U6_T1_h1)

question: What is a primary clinical use for serotonin 5-HT3 receptor antagonists like ondansetron?

options.A: Suppressing chronic epileptic seizures in children
options.B: Treating acute bacterial gastroenteritis and diarrhea
options.C: Lowering systemic blood pressure during hypertensive crisis
options.D: Preventing chemotherapy-induced and postoperative nausea

explanation: Ondansetron and similar agents are specifically designed and widely prescribed to prevent nausea and vomiting triggered by chemotherapy and surgical anesthesia. [learn more](GNS223_U3_T6#GNS223_U3_T6_h3)

question: Why is the use of non-vented goggles and full face shields mandatory when caring for a patient with active EVD?

options.A: To shield the eyes from harsh fluorescent lighting inside isolation units
options.B: To protect mucous membranes from splashes of infectious body fluids
options.C: To keep facial skin cool and prevent excessive perspiration
options.D: To prevent the inhalation of microscopic airborne virus particles

explanation: Mucous membranes of the eyes, nose, and mouth serve as direct entry portals if splattered with blood, vomit, or diarrhea during care. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T11#GNS214_U1_T11_h6)

question: How should surgical forceps be used when handling the extracted tissue specimen during a punch biopsy?

options.A: Twist the tissue specimen rapidly until it detaches from the subcutaneous fat
options.B: Firmly squeeze the entire surface of the specimen to control bleeding
options.C: Gently grasp only the very base or surrounding dermis to avoid crushing artifacts
options.D: Use toothed forceps to puncture the center of the epidermis for stability

explanation: Crushing the delicate cellular architecture with forceps damages the sample and makes accurate pathological interpretation difficult. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T3#GNS213_U5_T3_h5)

question: Which indicator is most directly linked to measuring the utilization of preventive reproductive health services?

options.A: Total hospital bed capacity count
options.B: Frequency of facility structural repainting
options.C: Antenatal care attendance rates
options.D: Average length of administrative staff tenure

explanation: Tracking how many pregnant women attend antenatal clinics reveals how well preventive services reach the community. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T2#GNS312_U5_T2_h6)
